name.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opens the Tongji Canal

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿通济渠，连接洛阳与淮河。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Tongji Canal, linking Luoyang with the Huai River.

description.zh: 605 年，隋炀帝下令开凿通济渠，自洛阳西苑引谷、洛水入黄河，再引黄河水入淮河。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 605, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Tongji Canal to be dug, linking Luoyang with the Yellow River and then the Huai River. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿永济渠，北通涿郡。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Yongji Canal northward to Zhuojun.

description.zh: 608 年，隋炀帝下令开凿永济渠，引沁水南达黄河，北通涿郡。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 608, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Yongji Canal to be dug, connecting the Yellow River with Zhuojun in the north. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Opening the Jiangnan Canal

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿江南河，连接京口与余杭。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Jiangnan Canal between Jingkou and Yuhang.

description.zh: 610 年，隋炀帝下令开凿江南河，自京口至余杭，沟通长江与钱塘江。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 610, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Jiangnan Canal to be dug from Jingkou to Yuhang, linking the Yangtze and Qiantang rivers. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Sui-Tang Grand Canal takes shape

summary.zh: 通济渠、永济渠、江南河相继完成，隋唐大运河形成。
summary.en: The Tongji, Yongji, and Jiangnan canals were completed, forming the Sui-Tang Grand Canal.

description.zh: 611 年前后，通济渠、永济渠、江南河相继完成，以洛阳为中心的隋唐大运河形成。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Around 611, the Tongji, Yongji, and Jiangnan canals were completed, forming the Sui-Tang Grand Canal centered on Luoyang. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Tang dynasty grain transport flourishes

summary.zh: 唐代以洛阳、长安为中心，漕运依赖运河。
summary.en: In the Tang dynasty, grain transport centered on Luoyang and Chang’an relied on the canal.

description.zh: 8 世纪前期，唐代漕运以洛阳、长安为中心，江淮粮米经运河转运关中。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early eighth century, Tang grain transport centered on Luoyang and Chang’an, moving grain from the Jiang-Huai region to the Guanzhong plain via the canal. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Luoyang as the center of the Sui-Tang canal

summary.zh: 唐代洛阳仍是运河漕运中心。
summary.en: In the Tang dynasty, Luoyang remained the center of canal grain transport.

description.zh: 8 世纪，唐代洛阳仍是运河漕运中心，江淮粮米经汴河、黄河转运关中。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the eighth century, Luoyang remained the center of Tang canal grain transport, with grain from the Jiang-Huai region moved via the Bian and Yellow rivers to the Guanzhong plain. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Song dynasty grain transport on the Bian River

summary.zh: 北宋以开封为中心，汴河成为漕运主干。
summary.en: The Northern Song centered on Kaifeng, with the Bian River as the main grain transport artery.

description.zh: 北宋建立后，以开封为中心，汴河成为连接江淮与京师的漕运主干。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the Northern Song was founded, Kaifeng became the capital and the Bian River became the main grain transport artery linking the Jiang-Huai region with the capital. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.author: 魏徵等
sources.note: 运河开凿时间参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: Kaifeng and the Bian River market towns

summary.zh: 北宋开封以汴河为漕运主干，汴河两岸码头、仓场与市镇连成一线。
summary.en: Northern Song Kaifeng depended on the Bian River, and wharves, granaries and market towns lined its banks.

description.zh: 北宋东京开封以汴河为漕运主干，江淮粮船经汴河入京。汴河穿城而过，州桥、相国寺桥一带为码头与商业中心；《东京梦华录》记汴河「自西京洛口分水入京城」，城内河道与蔡河、五丈河相通，沿岸有仓场、邸店、酒楼与瓦子，形成「因运而兴」的市镇带。张择端《清明上河图》所绘即以汴河两岸的码头与市镇为对象，年代与地点另有异说。本事件为城镇经济节点，不绘路线；日期取 1100 年代表年。
description.en: Northern Song Kaifeng, the eastern capital, depended on the Bian River for grain transport, and grain boats from the Jiangnan and Huai regions entered the city by it. The Bian ran through the city, with the Zhouqiao and Xiangguosi bridges as wharf and commercial centres. The Dongjing Meng Hua Lu records that the Bian drew water from the Luo mouth at the western capital into the city, and the inner waterways connected with the Cai and Wuzhang rivers; granaries, inns, taverns and entertainment quarters lined the banks, forming a canal-generated belt of market towns. Zhang Zeduan’s Qingming Shanghe Tu depicts wharves and towns on the Bian, though its date and location are disputed. This is a town-economy node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1100.

name.en: Hangzhou and Southern Song grain transport

summary.zh: 南宋临安依赖江南运河与浙东水系。
summary.en: Southern Song Lin’an relied on the Jiangnan Canal and the eastern Zhejiang waterways.

description.zh: 12 世纪，南宋临安（杭州）依赖江南运河与浙东水系维持漕运。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the twelfth century, Southern Song Lin’an (Hangzhou) relied on the Jiangnan Canal and eastern Zhejiang waterways for grain transport. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Yuan dynasty opens the Huitong Canal

summary.zh: 元代开凿会通河，打通山东段运河。
summary.en: The Yuan dynasty opened the Huitong Canal through Shandong.

description.zh: 1289 年，元代开凿会通河，自济宁至临清，打通山东段运河。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1289, the Yuan dynasty opened the Huitong Canal from Jining to Linqing, connecting the Shandong section of the canal. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Yuan dynasty opens the Tonghui Canal

summary.zh: 元代开凿通惠河，连接大都与通州。
summary.en: The Yuan dynasty opened the Tonghui Canal, linking Dadu with Tongzhou.

description.zh: 1293 年，元代开凿通惠河，连接大都与通州，使运河船只可直达都城。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1293, the Yuan dynasty opened the Tonghui Canal, linking Dadu with Tongzhou so that canal boats could reach the capital. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal is completed

summary.zh: 会通河、通惠河与旧有运河连接，京杭大运河全线贯通。
summary.en: With the Huitong and Tonghui canals linked to older waterways, the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal was completed.

description.zh: 1293 年，会通河、通惠河与旧有运河连接，北京至杭州的京杭大运河全线贯通。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1293, the Huitong and Tonghui canals were linked with older waterways, completing the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Jining as the Huitong Canal hub

summary.zh: 济宁成为会通河与泗水水系交汇的枢纽。
summary.en: Jining became the hub where the Huitong Canal met the Si River system.

description.zh: 14 世纪初，济宁成为会通河与泗水水系交汇的枢纽，是山东段运河的重要码头。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early fourteenth century, Jining became the hub where the Huitong Canal met the Si River system and an important wharf on the Shandong section. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Tianjin as the junction of sea and canal transport

summary.zh: 元代天津成为海漕与运河交汇点。
summary.en: In the Yuan dynasty, Tianjin became the junction of sea and canal transport.

description.zh: 14 世纪初，元代天津成为海漕与运河交汇点，南北粮运在此转运。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early fourteenth century, Tianjin became the junction of Yuan sea and canal transport, where north-south grain shipments were transshipped. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.author: 魏徵等
sources.note: 运河开凿时间参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: Ming dynasty grain transport system

summary.zh: 明代确立以运河为主的漕运制度。
summary.en: The Ming dynasty established a grain transport system centered on the canal.

description.zh: 15 世纪初，明代确立以运河为主的漕运制度，每年转运数百万石粮米至北京。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early fifteenth century, the Ming dynasty established a grain transport system centered on the canal, moving millions of shi of grain to Beijing each year. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《隋书·炀帝纪》
sources.author: 魏徵等
sources.note: 运河开凿时间参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The Dezhou granary and South Canal transshipment

summary.zh: 明代在德州设中转仓，南来漕粮于此收贮、盘拨，再转入北运。
summary.en: Under the Ming a transshipment granary at Dezhou stored and re-loaded southbound grain before it continued north.

description.zh: 明初沿用元代运河，永乐年间疏浚会通河后全线通漕。明廷沿运设淮安、徐州、临清、德州等中转仓（通行说法为「四仓」），漕粮分程盘拨；德州位于卫河（南运河）段，为山东北段重要仓场与码头，南来粮船在此交仓、换船。仓名、建置年份与存粮额待考；日期取 1450 年代表年。
description.en: The early Ming used the Yuan canal, and after the Huitong River was dredged in the Yongle reign the whole line carried grain again. The court set up transshipment granaries along the canal at Huai’an, Xuzhou, Linqing and Dezhou (conventionally the “four granaries”), and grain was re-loaded stage by stage. Dezhou stood on the Wei, the southern canal, and was an important granary and wharf on the northern Shandong section where grain boats handed over their cargo and changed vessels. The granary names, foundation dates and storage quotas await verification; the date is a representative year around 1450.

sources.title: 《明史·食货志》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 漕运中转仓：淮安、徐州、临清、德州

name.en: The Huai’an grain transport governor

summary.zh: 明代淮安设漕运总督，统管运河漕运。
summary.en: In the Ming dynasty, the grain transport governor was stationed at Huai’an.

description.zh: 15 世纪中期，明代淮安设漕运总督，统管运河漕运与河道。日期与制度为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-fifteenth century, the Ming grain transport governor was stationed at Huai’an, overseeing canal grain transport and waterways. Dates and institutions follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《隋书·炀帝纪》
sources.author: 魏徵等
sources.note: 运河开凿时间参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The Linqing customs house

summary.zh: 明宣德年间设临清钞关，为运河沿线重要税关，商税收入长期居前列。
summary.en: The Linqing customs house, set up in the Xuande reign, was one of the canal’s main tax barriers and long ranked among the highest in revenue.

description.zh: 明宣德四年（1429）始设钞关，临清为运河沿线钞关之一。往来商船按载货量纳税；临清因会通河与卫河交汇、南北商货辐辏，成为运河税关重镇，商税收入长期居各关前列（具体数额异说较多，不取）。临清同时设有中转仓。本事件为税关与商业节点，不绘路线；日期取 1450 年代表年。
description.en: Customs houses were established from 1429, the fourth year of Xuande, and Linqing was one of them. Merchant boats paid duty according to cargo volume; because the Huitong and Wei rivers met there and goods from north and south converged, Linqing became a major customs town whose revenue long ranked among the highest of the canal barriers (the exact figures vary and are not adopted here). Linqing also had a transshipment granary. This is a customs and commercial node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1450.

sources.title: 《临清州志》
sources.author: 临清市地方史志编纂委员会

name.en: The Tongzhou granaries and grain entering the capital

summary.zh: 明代通州为漕粮入京门户，设仓场收贮，再经通惠河或陆运入京。
summary.en: Tongzhou was the gateway for grain entering the Ming capital: it was stored in local granaries, then carried on by the Tonghui River or overland.

description.zh: 明代漕粮经运河抵通州，于张家湾、通州一带卸船入仓，再经通惠河或陆路车运入京仓。通州设有大运仓等仓场（仓名与建置年代待考），是京仓体系的前端。明中期多次修治通惠河，部分漕粮得以水运至北京城下，但多数年份仍需陆运。本事件为仓场节点，不绘路线；日期取 1450 年代表年。
description.en: Ming tribute grain reached Tongzhou by canal, was unloaded at Zhangjiawan and Tongzhou into granaries, and then went on to the capital’s granaries by the Tonghui River or by cart. Tongzhou had granaries such as the Dayun store (names and foundation dates await verification) and formed the front end of the capital granary system. The Tonghui River was repaired several times in the mid-Ming so that part of the grain could go by water to the walls of Beijing, but in most years carts were still needed. This is a granary node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1450.

sources.title: 《通州志》
sources.author: 北京市通州区地方志编纂委员会

name.en: Zhenjiang as the canal’s Yangtze entrance

summary.zh: 镇江是江南运河入长江口，南北转运要冲。
summary.en: Zhenjiang was the Jiangnan Canal’s entrance to the Yangtze and a key transshipment point.

description.zh: 15 世纪中期，镇江是江南运河入长江口，南北粮运在此转运。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-fifteenth century, Zhenjiang was the Jiangnan Canal’s entrance to the Yangtze and a key transshipment point for north-south grain. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《隋书·炀帝纪》
sources.author: 魏徵等
sources.note: 运河开凿时间参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: Qing dynasty grain transport at its height

summary.zh: 清代前期漕运达到鼎盛，运河沿线市镇繁荣。
summary.en: In the early and mid-Qing, grain transport reached its height and canal towns flourished.

description.zh: 18 世纪中期，清代漕运达到鼎盛，运河沿线市镇繁荣。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-eighteenth century, Qing grain transport reached its height and towns along the canal flourished. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《隋书·炀帝纪》
sources.author: 魏徵等
sources.note: 运河开凿时间参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: Suzhou’s silk and rice markets

summary.zh: 清代苏州为江南漕粮与丝货集散地，枫桥米市、阊门一带商业繁盛。
summary.en: Qing Suzhou was a collection and distribution centre for Jiangnan grain and silk, with the Fengqiao rice market and the Changmen quarter thriving.

description.zh: 清代苏州是江南漕粮与丝货的集散中心。城西枫桥为著名米市，湖广、江西米船经运河而来；阊门内外为商货码头，丝绸、棉布由此北运。苏州织造、漕粮转运与丝米贸易相互支撑，府城与运河、娄江、吴淞江水网连成一体。本事件为市场节点，不绘路线；日期取 1750 年代表年。
description.en: Qing Suzhou was a collection and distribution centre for Jiangnan tribute grain and silk. The Fengqiao market west of the city was a famous rice market reached by grain boats from Huguang and Jiangxi via the canal; the Changmen quarter inside and outside the gate was a goods wharf from which silk and cotton cloth went north. The Suzhou imperial silkworks, grain transshipment and the silk-rice trade supported one another, and the prefectural city was linked into the canal, Lou and Wusong river network. This is a market node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1750.

sources.title: 《苏州府志》
sources.author: 同治《苏州府志》
sources.note: 枫桥米市、阊门商货与运河

sources.title: 《吴县志》
sources.author: 吴县地方志编纂委员会

sources.title: 《中国运河志》
sources.author: 邹逸麟主编
sources.note: 清代江南运河与苏州市场

name.en: Yangzhou’s salt trade

summary.zh: 清代两淮盐运使司驻扬州，盐船经运河转运，盐商云集。
summary.en: The Qing Lianghuai salt commissioner sat at Yangzhou, salt boats moved by canal trade routes, and salt merchants gathered in the city.

description.zh: 清代两淮盐运使司驻扬州，两淮盐场所产之盐经运河与长江转运各地；盐商聚集扬州，园林、书院与市镇因盐利而兴。盐运与漕运共用运河航道，但管理机关不同：盐政归盐运使司，漕粮归漕运总督，两条系统在淮扬段并行。本事件为盐运与市场节点，不绘路线；日期取 1750 年代表年。
description.en: Under the Qing the Lianghuai salt commissioner was based at Yangzhou, and salt from the Lianghuai salterns was shipped to markets by canal and Yangtze. Salt merchants gathered in Yangzhou, and gardens, academies and market towns grew on salt profits. Salt and tribute grain shared the canal channel but had separate administrations: salt under the salt commissioner, grain under the director-general of grain transport, the two systems running side by side on the Huai–Yangzhou section. This is a salt-trade and market node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1750.

sources.title: 《两淮盐法志》
sources.author: 嘉庆《两淮盐法志》
sources.note: 两淮盐运使司、盐引与转运

sources.title: 《扬州府志》
sources.author: 扬州市地方志编纂委员会

name.en: The Yellow River changes course and damages the canal

summary.zh: 咸丰五年，黄河在兰考铜瓦厢决口改道，冲断运河，山东段漕运受阻。
summary.en: In 1855 the Yellow River burst its banks at Tongwaxiang in Lankao and changed course, breaking the canal and disrupting grain transport in Shandong.

description.zh: 清咸丰五年（1855）六月，黄河在河南兰考铜瓦厢决口，向北改道，经长垣、东明、濮州、范县、寿张、张秋，穿运河后夺大清河入海。改道冲断会通河，山东段运河淤塞，漕运受阻；此后黄河长期夺大清河入海，运河治理更加困难。铜瓦厢改道是京杭大运河由盛转衰的关键自然—工程事件。日期取决口发生的 1855 年 8 月（咸丰五年六月），具体日待考。
description.en: In the sixth month of the fifth year of Xianfeng (August 1855), the Yellow River burst at Tongwaxiang in Lankao, Henan, and shifted north through Changyuan, Dongming, Puzhou, Fanxian, Shouzhang and Zhangqiu, crossing the canal and taking over the Daqing River to the sea. The shift cut the Huitong River, silted the Shandong section and obstructed grain transport; thereafter the Yellow River long followed the Daqing channel, making canal management far harder. The Tongwaxiang shift was the key natural and engineering event in the Grand Canal’s decline. The date is given as August 1855 (sixth month of Xianfeng 5); the exact day awaits verification.

name.en: Liu Yan’s reform of grain transport

summary.zh: 广德二年，刘晏主持疏浚汴渠、造歇艎支江船，改直运为分段转运。
summary.en: In 764 Liu Yan dredged the Bian canal and replaced through-shipping with segmented transport.

description.zh: 唐代宗广德二年（764），刘晏领东都、河南、淮西、江南东西转运使，主持漕运改革。他组织疏浚汴渠，在扬州设船场造「歇艎支江船」二千艘，每船受千斛；改直运为分段转运，使江船不入汴、汴船不入河、河船不入渭，沿扬州、汴口、河阴、渭口置仓转输；又用盐利雇募船工，十船为纲，军官押运。改革后江淮漕粮岁运四十万至一百一十万石，损耗大减。本事件为制度事件，不绘路线。
description.en: In 764, the second year of Guangde under Emperor Daizong, Liu Yan took charge of transport for the eastern capital, Henan, Huaixi and the Jiangnan regions and reformed the grain system. He dredged the Bian canal, built 2,000 “Xiehuang Zhijiang” barges at Yangzhou (each carrying 1,000 hu), replaced through-shipping with segmented transport so that river boats did not enter the Bian, Bian boats did not enter the Yellow River and river boats did not enter the Wei, and set up granaries at Yangzhou, the Bian mouth, Heyin and the Wei mouth. He hired crews with salt revenue, grouped ten boats into a convoy and had officers escort them. Annual deliveries rose to 400,000–1,100,000 shi with much less loss. This is an institutional event, so no route is drawn.

name.en: Diverting the Luo River into the Bian Canal

summary.zh: 元丰二年，宋用臣主持引洛水入汴，避开黄河泥沙，改善汴河漕运。
summary.en: In 1079 Song Yongchen diverted the Luo into the Bian, avoiding Yellow River silt and improving transport.

description.zh: 北宋汴河原引黄河水，泥沙淤积严重，每年需大量人力清淤。元丰二年（1079）三月，宋神宗命宋用臣提举导洛通汴；四月甲子兴工，自巩县任村沙谷至河阴汴口开河五十余里，引伊、洛水入汴，并闭断黄河汴口。六月戊申完工，历时四十五日。工程使汴河由「黄汴」变为「清汴」，泥沙大减，四时通漕；但洛水夏秋涨落不定，水量有限，仍不能完全解决浅涩问题。本事件为水利工程，不绘路线。
description.en: The Northern Song Bian canal originally drew on the Yellow River and silted heavily, requiring massive annual dredging. In 1079 Emperor Shenzong ordered Song Yongchen to divert the Luo into the Bian. Work began in April, cutting a channel of more than fifty li from Rencun in Gong County to the Bian mouth at Heyin, leading the Yi and Luo rivers into the Bian and closing the Yellow River intake. It was completed in June after forty-five days. The “Yellow Bian” became the “Clear Bian”, silt fell sharply and transport ran in all seasons; but the Luo’s summer-autumn fluctuations and limited flow left shallows unresolved. No route is drawn.

name.en: The Southern Song makes Lin’an its temporary capital

summary.zh: 绍兴八年，南宋以临安为行在（名义首都仍为汴京），江南运河成为行在的漕运通道。
summary.en: In 1138 the Southern Song made Lin’an its temporary capital (xingzai) while nominally retaining Bianjing, and the Jiangnan canal became the court’s grain route.

description.zh: 绍兴八年（1138），南宋正式以临安（今杭州）为行在（皇帝临时驻地），名义上仍以汴京为首都。临安位于江南运河南端，经运河可北接镇江、扬州，转入长江与淮河；行在所需的粮米、布帛、木材与日用百货多由江南运河输入。南宋在临安设转运司、仓场与河码头，城北湖墅、江涨桥一带因运河而兴。严格说，临安是「行在」而非正式首都；「定都临安」是后世的通行简写。本事件为政治事件，不绘路线。
description.en: In 1138 the Southern Song formally made Lin’an (present-day Hangzhou) its xingzai, the emperor’s temporary residence, while Bianjing remained the nominal capital. At the southern end of the Jiangnan canal, Lin’an was linked north to Zhenjiang and Yangzhou and thence to the Yangtze and Huai. Grain, cloth, timber and daily goods for the court came largely by the Jiangnan canal. The Southern Song set up transport offices, granaries and wharves, and the city’s northern lakeside and riverine quarters grew around the canal. Strictly speaking Lin’an was a temporary capital, not the formal capital; “establishing the capital at Lin’an” is a later shorthand. No route is drawn.

name.en: Opening of the Jizhou River

summary.zh: 至元二十年，济州河竣工，自济宁北至安山，接通大清河。
summary.en: In 1283 the Jizhou River was completed from Jining north to Anshan, linking to the Daqing River.

description.zh: 元至元十七年（1280），朝廷采纳姚演、马之贞等建议，决定开济州河。工程于至元十九年（1282）十二月正式施工，至次年八月竣工，自济州（今济宁）鲁桥引汶、泗水，北至须城（今东平）安山，全长约一百五十里，接通大清河。济州河使江南漕船可经泗水、济州河北上，但安山以北仍需陆运至临清，或由利津出海；直到 1289 年会通河开通，南北直航才实现。本事件为水利工程，线路见「济宁—安山（济州河）」。
description.en: In 1280 the Yuan court adopted proposals by Yao Yan and Ma Zhizhen to open the Jizhou River. Work began in December 1282 and was completed in August 1283, running from the Luqiao area of Jizhou (Jining) north to Anshan in Xucheng (Dongping), about 150 li, using the Wen and Si rivers and linking to the Daqing River. It allowed grain boats from the south to reach Anshan, but goods still had to go overland to Linqing or by sea from Lijin until the Huitong River opened in 1289. The route is shown as Jining–Anshan.

name.en: The Nanwang water-diversion hub

summary.zh: 永乐九年，宋礼、白英修会通河，引汶水至南旺分水，解决运河「水脊」难题。
summary.en: In 1411 Song Li and Bai Ying diverted the Wen River to Nanwang, solving the canal’s summit water problem.

description.zh: 明永乐九年（1411），工部尚书宋礼奉命疏浚会通河，采纳汶上老人白英的建议，在汶河戴村筑坝遏水，开小汶河引汶水至南旺；南旺为运河全线最高点，号称「水脊」。工程在汶、运交汇处筑石护岸，设鱼嘴状「水拨刺」分水南北，并设南旺、蜀山、马踏等水柜蓄水，沿河置闸节流。民间称「七分朝天子，三分下江南」，实际分流比例随水势调整。南旺枢纽使会通河获得稳定水源，保障京杭大运河明清近六百年通航。
description.en: In 1411, the ninth year of Yongle, Minister of Works Song Li was ordered to dredge the Huitong River. On the advice of the Wenshang water expert Bai Ying, he built the Daicun dam across the Wen, cut the Xiao Wen channel and led the Wen to Nanwang, the highest point of the canal, known as the “water ridge”. At the Wen–canal junction the engineers built stone revetments and a fish-mouth divider to split the flow north and south, created reservoirs at Nanwang, Shushan and Mata, and placed locks along the channel. The popular saying “seven parts to the emperor, three to the south” describes the ideal split; actual proportions varied with water levels. The hub gave the Huitong River a stable water supply and kept the Grand Canal navigable for nearly six centuries under the Ming and Qing.

name.en: The Hushu market town at Lin’an

summary.zh: 南宋临安城北湖墅、江涨桥一带因运河码头形成市镇。
summary.en: In the Southern Song the Hushu and Jiangzhangqiao area north of Lin’an grew into a market town around the canal wharves.

description.zh: 南宋临安城北的湖墅、江涨桥一带位于江南运河入城段，是粮船、商船停泊与转运的码头区。据《梦粱录》《咸淳临安志》，此处有米市、鱼行、船行、货栈与仓场，外来商旅在此卸货入城；城北河道与城内河网相连，形成「运河—湖墅—城内」的运输链。湖墅市镇是运河沿线「因运而兴」的典型节点。本事件为城镇经济节点，不绘路线。
description.en: The Hushu and Jiangzhangqiao area north of Southern Song Lin’an lay on the Jiangnan canal’s approach to the city and served as the wharf zone for grain and merchant boats. According to the Mengliang Lu and Xianchun Lin’an Zhi, it had rice markets, fish and boat brokers, warehouses and granaries where travelling merchants unloaded goods for the city; the northern waterways connected with the city’s canal network, forming a “canal–Hushu–city” transport chain. Hushu is a classic canal-generated town. No route is drawn.

name.en: The Sui Hangou canal

summary.zh: 隋代沟通淮安与扬州的邗沟，是隋唐大运河连接淮河与长江的南段。
summary.en: The Sui Hangou canal linked Huai’an and Yangzhou, connecting the Huai and the Yangtze in the southern Sui–Tang system.

description.zh: 邗沟始凿于春秋吴王夫差，隋代加以疏浚改线。隋文帝开山阳渎，隋炀帝大业年间复开邗沟，自山阳（今淮安）南至江都（今扬州）入长江，沟通淮河与长江。邗沟是隋唐大运河的南段，也是后来京杭大运河里运河的前身。本事件为运河工程，线路见「淮安—扬州（邗沟）」。
description.en: The Hangou canal was first cut under King Fuchai of Wu and was dredged and realigned in the Sui period. Emperor Wen opened the Shanyang channel and Emperor Yang reopened the Hangou, running from Shanyang (Huai’an) south to Jiangdu (Yangzhou) and the Yangtze, linking the Huai and the Yangtze. It was the southern section of the Sui–Tang Grand Canal and the forerunner of the later Li canal. The route is shown as Huai’an–Yangzhou.

sources.title: 《京杭大运河志》
sources.author: 中国大运河志编纂委员会

name.en: Sui Jiangdu

summary.zh: 扬州（江都）是隋代邗沟南端与长江交汇处的运河枢纽。
summary.en: Yangzhou (Jiangdu) was the canal hub where the Sui Hangou met the Yangtze.

description.zh: 江都（今扬州）位于邗沟南端、长江北岸，是隋唐大运河连接江南河与淮河的关键节点。隋炀帝开邗沟后，江都成为巡幸、转漕与南北商旅集散之地；唐代继续在此设仓、造船，刘晏漕运改革即以扬州为造船与转输中心。本事件为运河枢纽节点，不绘路线。
description.en: Jiangdu (present-day Yangzhou) stood at the southern end of the Hangou on the north bank of the Yangtze, the key node linking the Jiangnan canal with the Huai system. After Emperor Yang opened the Hangou, Jiangdu became a centre for imperial tours, grain transshipment and north–south trade; the Tang continued to build granaries and ships there, and Liu Yan’s reforms made Yangzhou a shipbuilding and transshipment hub. No route is drawn.

name.en: Pei Yaoqing’s reform of grain transport

summary.zh: 开元二十一年，裴耀卿改直运为分段转运，置河阴等仓，三年运七百万石。
summary.en: In 733 Pei Yaoqing replaced through-shipping with segmented transport and set up granaries, moving seven million shi in three years.

description.zh: 唐玄宗开元二十一年（733），裴耀卿任京兆尹、江淮都转运使，改革漕运。他改直运为分段转运：于河阴置河阴仓，河清置柏崖仓，三门东置集津仓、西置盐仓；江南漕船至河口入仓，官雇舟分入河、洛，避免江南船工不习黄河水性的风险。三年运粮七百万石，省陆运钱三十万缗。日期取 733 年，具体月日待考。
description.en: In 733, the twenty-first year of Kaiyuan, Pei Yaoqing became governor of the capital region and transport commissioner and reformed grain transport. He replaced through-shipping with segmented transport: granaries were set up at Heyin, Baiya, Jijin and the Salt Storehouse at Sanmen; southern boats unloaded at the river mouth and official vessels carried the grain into the Yellow River and Luo. In three years 7,000,000 shi were moved, saving 300,000 strings of cash in overland costs. The date is 733; the exact month and day await verification.

name.en: Construction of the Hanjia Granary

summary.zh: 隋大业年间营建含嘉仓，唐代沿用，是洛阳运河枢纽的皇家粮仓。
summary.en: The Hanjia Granary was built under the Sui and used by the Tang as the imperial store at the Luoyang canal hub.

description.zh: 含嘉仓位于隋唐洛阳城北，隋大业年间营建，唐代继续使用，是隋唐大运河洛阳枢纽的皇家粮仓。遗址发现仓窖数百座，出土铭砖记载储粮来源、数量与入仓时间，可证江淮漕粮经通济渠、汴河转运至洛阳。日期取隋大业年间（605 年起），具体营建年待考。
description.en: The Hanjia Granary lay north of the Sui–Tang city of Luoyang. Built under the Sui and continued in use under the Tang, it was the imperial store of the Luoyang canal hub. Hundreds of granary pits have been excavated, and inscribed bricks record the origin, quantity and date of stored grain, evidence that Jiangnan grain reached Luoyang via the Tongji and Bian canals. The date is the Daye era from 605; the exact year awaits verification.

sources.title: 《洛阳含嘉仓遗址发掘报告》
sources.author: 河南省博物馆、洛阳市博物馆

name.en: Six million shi on the Bian River

summary.zh: 北宋真宗时，汴河岁运江淮米达六百万石，为北宋漕运最高额之一。
summary.en: Under Emperor Zhenzong the Bian River carried up to six million shi of Jiangnan and Huai grain a year, among the highest Northern Song totals.

description.zh: 北宋以汴河为立国之本。真宗大中祥符年间，汴河岁运江淮米达六百万石，为北宋漕运最高额之一。汴河引黄河水，泥沙淤积严重，朝廷每年清淤、狭河、护堤；岁运额与河道维护能力直接相关。日期取 1010 年代表年，具体年份待考。
description.en: The Northern Song regarded the Bian River as the foundation of the state. Under Emperor Zhenzong, in the Dazhong Xiangfu era, the Bian carried up to 6,000,000 shi of grain from the Jiangnan and Huai regions a year, among the highest totals of the dynasty. Because the Bian drew on the silt-laden Yellow River, the court dredged, narrowed and diked it every year; the annual total depended directly on maintenance. The date is a representative year around 1010; the exact year awaits verification.

sources.title: 《宋代的运河与整顿》
sources.author: 陈炯智，台湾师范大学历史文化学习网

name.en: Guo Shoujing surveys the canal routes

summary.zh: 至元十二年，郭守敬勘察汶、泗、卫水道，为元代山东运河与通惠河奠定技术基础。
summary.en: In 1275 Guo Shoujing surveyed the Wen, Si and Wei waters, laying the technical basis for the Yuan Shandong canals and Tonghui River.

description.zh: 元至元十二年（1275），元世祖命郭守敬勘察汶、泗、卫相邻地区水道，为开凿济州河、会通河与通惠河作技术准备。郭守敬绘图上报，提出引汶、泗水济运的方案，并测定地形高差，奠定元代山东运河与通惠河工程的基础。日期取 1275 年。
description.en: In 1275, the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, Kublai Khan ordered Guo Shoujing to survey the waterways between the Wen, Si and Wei rivers as technical preparation for the Jizhou, Huitong and Tonghui canals. Guo mapped the terrain, measured heights and proposed diverting the Wen and Si to supply the canal, laying the basis for the Yuan works in Shandong and the Tonghui River. The date is 1275.

name.en: Ma Zhizhen directs the Huitong River works

summary.zh: 至元二十六年，马之贞与韩仲晖、边源等主持开凿会通河，建闸三十余座。
summary.en: In 1289 Ma Zhizhen, Han Zhonghui and Bian Yuan directed the Huitong River works and built more than thirty locks.

description.zh: 至元二十六年（1289），漕运副使马之贞与寿张尹韩仲晖、太史院令史边源等主持开凿会通河，自安山至临清，长二百五十余里，引汶、泗水济运，沿河建闸三十余座，以时启闭。会通河开通后，京杭大运河全线贯通。日期取 1289 年，具体月日待考。
description.en: In 1289 Ma Zhizhen, transport vice-commissioner, with Han Zhonghui, magistrate of Shouzhang, and Bian Yuan of the Astronomical Bureau, directed the Huitong River works from Anshan to Linqing, over 250 li, diverting the Wen and Si to supply the canal and building more than thirty locks opened and closed according to water levels. With the Huitong open, the Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal ran through. The date is 1289; the exact month and day await verification.

name.en: Chen Xuan opens the Qingjiangpu channel

summary.zh: 永乐十三年，陈瑄开清江浦，使漕船自淮安直达淮河，免陆运过坝。
summary.en: In 1415 Chen Xuan opened the Qingjiangpu channel, letting grain boats reach the Huai directly and avoid portage over the dams.

description.zh: 永乐十三年（1415），总督漕运陈瑄开清江浦，自淮安城西管家湖凿渠二十里，导水入淮，使漕船免过仁字坝、车轮坝陆运之劳，直达淮河。清江浦由此成为明清漕运总督驻地与运河重镇。日期取 1415 年。
description.en: In 1415 Chen Xuan, director-general of grain transport, opened the Qingjiangpu channel, cutting a twenty-li canal from Guanjiacu Lake west of Huai’an to lead water into the Huai and allow grain boats to bypass the Renzi and Chelun dams and their portage. Qingjiangpu became the seat of the Ming–Qing grain transport commissioner and a major canal town. The date is 1415.

sources.title: 《京杭大运河志》
sources.author: 中国大运河志编纂委员会

name.zh: 潘叔正上书疏浚会通河
name.en: Pan Shuzheng petitions to dredge the Huitong River

summary.zh: 永乐九年，济宁州同知潘叔正上书请疏浚会通河，明成祖采纳，命宋礼等兴工。
summary.en: In 1411 Pan Shuzheng, sub-prefect of Jining, petitioned to dredge the Huitong River; the Yongle Emperor agreed and ordered Song Li to begin work.

description.zh: 永乐九年（1411），济宁州同知潘叔正上书，言会通河四百五十余里，淤塞者三分之一，请疏浚以通漕运。明成祖采纳，命工部尚书宋礼、刑部侍郎金纯、都督同知周长征民夫十六万余人疏浚会通河；随后宋礼采纳白英建议，建南旺分水枢纽。日期取 1411 年。
description.en: In 1411 Pan Shuzheng, sub-prefect of Jining, petitioned that one third of the 450-li Huitong River was silted and asked for dredging to restore grain transport. The Yongle Emperor agreed and ordered Minister of Works Song Li, Vice Minister of Justice Jin Chun and Commander Zhou Chang to mobilise more than 160,000 labourers. Song Li then adopted Bai Ying’s plan and built the Nanwang water-diversion hub. The date is 1411.

name.en: Wan Gong directs river management

summary.zh: 隆庆末至万历初，万恭总理河道，主张束水攻沙，治理黄河与运河。
summary.en: In the late Longqing and early Wanli reigns Wan Gong directed river management, advocating confined-flow scouring of the Yellow River and canal.

description.zh: 隆庆末至万历初，万恭总理河道，治理黄河与运河。他主张「束水攻沙」，修堤束窄河身、以水刷沙，并在山东、淮扬一带修闸、浚河、筑堤；所著《治水筌蹄》总结其治河经验。日期取 1570 年代表年，具体任职月日待考。
description.en: From the late Longqing into the early Wanli reign Wan Gong directed river management, dealing with both the Yellow River and the canal. He advocated “confining the flow to scour the sand”, narrowing channels with dikes so that water would cut away sediment, and built locks, dredged channels and raised dikes in Shandong and the Huai–Yangzhou region. His Treatise on Water Control (Zhishui Quanti) summarised the experience. The date is a representative year around 1570; exact appointment dates await verification.

sources.title: 《中国水利史》
sources.author: 水利部水利水电科学研究院

name.en: Pan Jixun manages the rivers to protect the canal

summary.zh: 万历六年，潘季驯总理河道，筑高家堰、塞崔镇决口，以束水攻沙保护运河。
summary.en: In 1578 Pan Jixun directed river management, building the Gaojiayan dike and closing the Cuizhen breach to protect the canal by confined-flow scouring.

description.zh: 万历六年（1578），潘季驯总理河道，提出「筑堤束水、以水攻沙」，筑高家堰、塞崔镇决口、修清口，保护黄河与运河交汇段。其《河防一览》总结明代治河经验，强调堤防、缕堤、遥堤与减水坝配合，影响清代靳辅等人。日期取 1578 年。
description.en: In 1578 Pan Jixun became director-general of river management. He argued for “building dikes to confine the flow and using water to attack sand”, built the Gaojiayan dike, closed the Cuizhen breach and repaired the Qingkou junction to protect the meeting of the Yellow River and the canal. His Comprehensive Survey of River Defence (Hefang Yilan) summarised Ming practice, stressing the coordination of inner, outer and distant dikes with flood-relief dams, and influenced Qing engineers such as Jin Fu. The date is 1578.

name.en: Jin Fu and Chen Huang manage the rivers

summary.zh: 康熙十六年，靳辅任河道总督，陈潢协助，筑高家堰、疏清口、开中河。
summary.en: In 1677 Jin Fu became river viceroy and, with Chen Huang, built the Gaojiayan dike, cleared the Qingkou and opened the Middle River.

description.zh: 康熙十六年（1677），靳辅任河道总督，幕僚陈潢协助，提出「因势利导、束水攻沙」，筑高家堰、疏清口、开中河，使运河避开黄河险段。工程保障了康熙年间漕运，但也留下河床抬高、清口淤积等长期问题。日期取 1677 年。
description.en: In 1677 Jin Fu became river viceroy and, with his adviser Chen Huang, pursued “guiding the flow with the terrain and confining water to scour sand”. They rebuilt the Gaojiayan dike, cleared the Qingkou and opened the Middle River so that the canal could avoid the most dangerous stretch of the Yellow River. The works secured grain transport in the Kangxi reign but left long-term problems of raised beds and silting at Qingkou. The date is 1677.

sources.title: 《清史稿·靳辅传》
sources.author: 赵尔巽等
sources.note: 康熙十六年任河道总督、开中河

name.en: Zhang Penghe clears the Qingkou

summary.zh: 康熙三十九年，张鹏翮任河道总督，拆拦黄坝、疏清口，继续靳辅治河方针。
summary.en: In 1700 Zhang Penghe became river viceroy, removed the Yellow River barrier dam and cleared the Qingkou, continuing Jin Fu’s approach.

description.zh: 康熙三十九年（1700），张鹏翮任河道总督，拆拦黄坝、疏清口、筑高家堰，继续靳辅的治河方针，使黄河回归故道、运河畅通。其《治河全书》记录清代前期河工制度与工程。日期取 1700 年。
description.en: In 1700 Zhang Penghe became river viceroy. He removed the barrier dam across the Yellow River, cleared the Qingkou and strengthened the Gaojiayan dike, continuing Jin Fu’s approach and restoring the Yellow River to its old channel so that the canal could flow. His Complete Book of River Management (Zhihe Quanshu) records early Qing river administration and works. The date is 1700.

sources.title: 《京杭大运河志》
sources.author: 中国大运河志编纂委员会

name.en: Tao Shu and He Changling ship grain by sea

summary.zh: 道光六年，陶澍、贺长龄主持漕粮海运，自上海雇商船运至天津。
summary.en: In 1826 Tao Shu and He Changling organised sea transport of grain from Shanghai to Tianjin using merchant ships.

description.zh: 道光六年（1826），江苏巡抚陶澍、布政使贺长龄主持漕粮海运，雇商船自上海运苏、松、常、镇、太仓漕米至天津，以避运河淤塞。此次海运成功，为近代漕运改革先声；贺长龄辑《海运全案》记其始末。日期取 1826 年。
description.en: In 1826 Tao Shu, governor of Jiangsu, and He Changling, provincial administration commissioner, organised the sea transport of grain. Merchant ships carried the tribute rice of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang and Taicang from Shanghai to Tianjin, bypassing the silted canal. The success was a precedent for modern transport reform; He Changling compiled the Complete Record of Sea Transport (Haiyun Quanan). The date is 1826.

sources.title: 《中国近代交通史》
sources.author: 交通部交通史编纂委员会

name.en: The China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company carries tribute grain

summary.zh: 同治十一年，李鸿章创办轮船招商局，以蒸汽轮船承运江浙漕粮。
summary.en: In 1872 Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company, which carried Jiangsu–Zhejiang tribute grain by steamship.

description.zh: 同治十一年（1872），李鸿章创办轮船招商局，总局设上海，承运江浙漕粮，兼营客货。招商局以蒸汽轮船取代部分木帆船漕运，标志着运河漕运向近代航运过渡。日期取 1872 年。
description.en: In 1872 Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company, headquartered in Shanghai. It carried tribute grain from Jiangsu and Zhejiang and also operated passenger and freight services. Its steamships replaced part of the wooden-sail grain fleet and marked the transition from canal transport to modern shipping. The date is 1872.

sources.title: 《中国近代交通史》
sources.author: 交通部交通史编纂委员会

name.en: Jining city and its canal trade

summary.zh: 济宁位于会通河与泗水交汇处，明清时期成为鲁西南漕运与商业枢纽。
summary.en: At the meeting of the Huitong River and the Si, Jining became a grain-transport and commercial hub of southwest Shandong under the Ming and Qing.

description.zh: 济宁位于会通河与泗水交汇处，元代开河后成为鲁西南漕运枢纽；明清时期州城内外码头、仓场、商号密集，江淮粮船、货船在此停泊转运。济宁也是河道总督、漕运官员驻节与治河物资集散之地。日期取 1450 年代表年，具体市镇形成时间待考。
description.en: Jining stood where the Huitong River met the Si. After the Yuan canal works it became a grain-transport hub in southwest Shandong; under the Ming and Qing, wharves, granaries and shops clustered inside and outside the city, and grain and merchant boats from the Jiangnan and Huai regions stopped there for transshipment. It was also a seat for river and grain officials and a depot for river-works supplies. The date is a representative year around 1450; the exact period of the town’s growth awaits verification.
